name: weekly-threshold-duplicate-prevent
description: Requeue Threshold XP on an already-Processed WAS that still meets thresholds. Expect skip_existing (Source Key or XP Source label); no duplicate Source Keys.
prerequisites: SCN-025 passed (at least one Weekly Threshold XP Event exists for Schmidt + week)
setup_steps: Open the same Weekly Athlete Summary used in SCN-025
Confirm XP Events already exist with Source Key WEEKLY_THRESHOLD|recgP9qZYjAhE7NXm|{weekId}|{percent} OR XP Source Weekly Threshold {percent}
Set field Requeue Threshold XP = true
Run automation 035 Test with recordId = that WAS record id

input_fields.automation: 035 - Weekly Summary and Goal Logic - Create Weekly Threshold XP Events
input_fields.input_mapping: Same WAS record id as SCN-025

prohibited_side_effects: Second XP Event for same enrollment+week+percent
Second XP Event when only XP Source label matches (legacy key shape)
safe_rerun_behavior: skip_existing via source_key or xp_source_label; createdCountOut=0 for already-awarded tiers
cleanup_instructions: None if skip works; leave Threshold XP Status=Processed
manual_requirements: Optional legacy label case: see SCHMIDT-LIVE-PROOF Test 3
